title: ESRS-40a: From Reporting Scope to Audit-Ready Evidence
trigger: EFRAG held its final ESRS-40a outreach event on 29 October 2026, ahead of the 31 October consultation deadline for certain non-EU undertakings.
limitations: The eight controls, their weights and the resulting score constitute an original, illustrative internal governance diagnostic. They are not prescribed ESRS-40a requirements, an official compliance assessment, an assurance opinion or a regulatory scoring methodology. All default control statuses are synthetic and do not represent evidence obtained from any undertaking. The cited ESRS-40a material was at consultation stage; applicability and final legal requirements must be assessed separately against the relevant adopted framework.
formula: Illustrative diagnostic score = Σ(weight_i × status_factor_i), where Ready = 1, Partial = 0.5 and Missing = 0. Analyst-defined weights sum to 100: scope 15, boundary 15, materiality 10, IRO linkage 15, data lineage 15, control owners 10, cross-references 10 and assurance trail 10. Neither the weights nor the status factors are regulatory parameters.
decision: Use the diagnostic to identify potential evidence gaps and prioritise entity-boundary documentation, data lineage and cross-report traceability. Confirm the applicable legal reporting framework and assurance requirements independently. Do not use the diagnostic score to assert ESRS compliance or audit readiness.
worked_example: Under the synthetic default scenario, three controls are Partial, one is Ready and four are Missing, producing an analyst-defined diagnostic score of 30/100. The result is not based on company evidence and must not be interpreted as a regulatory compliance score, assurance conclusion or verified assessment of audit readiness.
